scope: Single disposable ARM64 VM; original ASUS ARM32 HTTPS/login/rc and unmodified real DDNS-Go plugin; no physical router/NIC
Thirty minutes measured with a monotonic clock after installation/setup; not accelerated time
New IDs for every request; queries during explicitly planned center/DDNS maintenance can be unavailable; UU restart must not interrupt queries
Owned synthetic UU monitor/heartbeat worker and test data; original native NTP/download/checksum startup flow
Test-only subreaper supplies orphan reaping for the minimal guest shell PID 1; it never kills live services
FD/RSS samples are observations per PID, not proof that no slow leak exists
not_tested: Real UU monitor/account/entitlement/game traffic or WAN provider APIs
Day/week-long operation, high client concurrency and all network failures
resource_observation: DDNS-Go QEMU process RSS increased in steps; cache/runtime/emulation overhead versus slow leak remains unclassified. FD counts are sampled, not a proof of leak freedom.
